title: Mooncake: Trading More Storage for Less Computation — A KVCache-centric Architecture for Serving LLM Chatbot
authors: Ruoyu Qin; Moonshot Ai; Jialei Cui; Moonshot Ai; Feng Ren; Mingxing Zhang; Yongwei Wu; Weimin Zheng
venue_full: USENIX Conference on File and Storage Technologies

problem_statement.en: LLM serving faces bottlenecks in maximizing throughput while meeting stringent latency-related Service Level Objectives (SLOs) for long-context inputs, exacerbated by the high cost of recomputing KVCache.
problem_statement.zh: LLM serving 在長 context 輸入下難以同時兼顧吞吐量極大化與嚴格的延遲 SLO，而 KVCache 重計算的高昂代價進一步加劇此困境。

key_innovation.en: A KVCache-centric disaggregated architecture that pools CPU, DRAM, SSD, and RDMA resources across a GPU cluster to create a global, distributed KVCache store, enabling efficient prefix caching and inter-node transfer.
key_innovation.zh: 以 KVCache 為中心的解耦合架構：將 GPU 叢集中的 CPU、DRAM、SSD 與 RDMA 資源匯聚為全域分散式 KVCache 儲存池，實現高效的 prefix caching 與節點間傳輸。

baselines_compared: vLLM, vLLM Prefix Caching, vLLM Chunked Prefill

key_improvements.en: Up to 498% increase in effective request capacity, 115% and 107% more requests handled on A800 and H800 clusters respectively, and up to 48% savings in prefill computation time.
key_improvements.zh: 有效請求容量最高提升 498%；A800 與 H800 叢集分別多處理 115% 與 107% 的請求；prefill 計算時間節省最高 48%。

ai_task: LLM Serving, LLM Chatbot, Long-context Inference
compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A800, H800, HBM, DRAM, SSD
